completeness.reason: 97% of rows carry timestamp + session/vote number + long title + a full reconciling tally (yes/no/abstain/notVoting/present). The 3% incomplete are procedural roll calls with an empty long title (e.g. psp:hlasovani:86345, 86346, 86347) — bod<1, a documented record type, not a scrape gap. Rounds to 5 on the deterministic scale.

freshness.reason: syncAgeDays=0 (ingested today) and rowLagDays=8 (newest roll call 2026-07-15 vs the snapshot) → deterministic freshness 4.5. The 8-day lag is a summer sitting gap, not a broken pipeline — the Chamber simply did not vote in the interval.

categorization.reason: 100% of rows resolve to a non-fallback kind (all normal; 0 manual, 0 technical_fault) AND a real outcome (accepted/rejected/quorum_not_reached), never the unknown/void fallback. The vocabulary maps cleanly.

validity.reason: 100% pass the arithmetic check yes+no+abstain+notVoting==present — the publisher's own tallies reconcile on every one of the 2030 rows — and no title carries U+FFFD. This is the strongest validity signal in the corpus because it is an internal-consistency proof, not just a referential one.

richness.reason: 0% of rows have BOTH a long AND a short title with a positive agenda item: nazev_kratky (short title) is empty for ~all PSP10 votes. This is a STRUCTURAL publisher cap for the current term, not a per-row defect — the long title carries the content, so the low score is honest but must not be read as 'missing data to scrape'.

volume.reason: 2030 roll calls ≥ 1000 → top band. A full term's voting record.

entityGaps.note: Procedural vote (bod<1) with an empty long title; expected for the record type, flagged not as a scrape target but so the completeness gap is attributable.

patterns: Vote-tally integrity is perfect: yes+no+abstain+notVoting==present on 100% of 2030 rows — the arithmetic invariant holds, so any downstream discipline/attendance metric can trust the aggregate counts without re-deriving them from ballots.

16 roll calls are voided (zmatečné) — their result was disregarded by the Chamber and they MUST be excluded from any discipline/attendance/outcome metric, or a rebellion will be attributed to a vote that legally did not count.
Short titles are empty corpus-wide for the current term, so any UI that shows a compact vote label has only the long title to truncate — a product concern, not a data-repair one.

opportunities.productImpact: Excluding voided votes from discipline/attendance is a correctness requirement for CivicScore's Independence pillar — including them would fabricate rebellions against non-votes.
